title: Listening Practice 2 - Renewable Energy Lecture
description: IELTS Listening Section 3: An academic lecture about renewable energy sources.

stimuli.title: Section 3: Renewable Energy Sources - Academic Discussion
stimuli.content: You will hear a tutorial discussion between a professor and two students about renewable energy research.

questionGroups.instruction: Questions 1-5: Choose the correct letter, A, B or C.

questions.content: What is the main focus of the students' research project?

options.label: A
options.content: Comparing costs of different energy sources

options.label: B
options.content: Evaluating the efficiency of solar panels

questions.content: What problem did the students encounter with their data collection?

options.label: A
options.content: The weather was too cloudy during the test period

options.label: C
options.content: They didn't have enough test subjects

questions.content: According to the professor, what is the biggest challenge for solar energy?
What does the professor suggest the students do next?

options.label: A
options.content: Repeat the experiment over a longer period

options.label: C
options.content: Focus only on wind energy instead

questions.content: When is the final report due?

questionGroups.instruction: Questions 6-10: Complete the notes below. Write NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS for each answer.
